ruleDefinitions.name: Potential RoboForm.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "roboform.dll", a DLL used by RoboForm Password Manager Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\roboform\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\roboform\\-x64\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^\\ C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Siber\\ Systems\\\\AI\\ RoboForm\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^\\ C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Siber\\ Systems\\\\AI\\ RoboForm\\\\")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\robotaskbaricon\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\robotaskbaricon\\-x64\\\.exe$"))))
